# Logistra

> Regional fulfilment infrastructure for growing D2C brands positioning selected inventory closer to demand in Eastern India.

Logistra is based in Patna, Bihar, India. It provides an assessment-led shared fulfilment model for D2C brands, marketplace sellers, and regional online businesses. Actual serviceability, order handoff, systems, costs, and operating responsibilities require confirmation.

## Core pages

- [Logistra homepage](https://www.logistra.in/): Overview of regional D2C fulfilment, inventory positioning, shared infrastructure, and the illustrative business case.
- [How fulfilment works](https://www.logistra.in/how-it-works): Receiving, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and RTO workflow.
- [Fulfilment services](https://www.logistra.in/services): Storage, pick and pack, dispatch, returns, and related agreed services.
- [Technology and operations](https://www.logistra.in/technology): Order handoff, inventory records, reporting, and capabilities requiring confirmation.
- [About Logistra](https://www.logistra.in/about): Company perspective and Patna, Bihar operating context.
- [Partner enquiry](https://www.logistra.in/contact): Share products, order profile, customer geography, and fulfilment requirements.
